With a culture of recognition and reputation for excellence, ELS is the ideal organization in which to develop a long and successful career!
ELS is hiring for the position of Administrative Assistant in Las Vegas, Nevada.
The Administrative Assistant helps to maintain property operations and to attract and serve guests and residents.

Greet guests in a professional and friendly manner.
Maintain open communications with all property and regional staff.
Work closely with management to develop an integral team that effectively represents the quality and professionalism of the company.
Process accounts payable within the automated accounting system.
Assist in processing procurement card reconciliations.
Organize and maintain files and order office supplies.
Research and implement company-sponsored activities.
Attend and participate in training programs and seminars as required.
Handle inquiries by telephone in order to back up property staff.
Run errands, including delivering various communications to guests or residents, as needed.

High school diploma, or the equivalent experience.
1+ year of office experience.
Strong communications and organizational skills.
Meticulous attention to detail.
Proficiency with computers, preferably Microsoft Word, Excel and/or automated accounting systems.
Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including weekends.
In return for your excellent skills and abilities, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental, and vision plans, a generous 401(k) employer match, and paid vacations, holidays, and sick time.
We invite you to visit our web site at www.equitylifestyleproperties.com for additional information regarding our exceptional resort communities.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome and thank all applicants.

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level. If this vacancy includes more than one grade and you are selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform these duties and receive training to help you grow in this position.

Leads the development, integration, and execution of strategic and operational plans aligned with agency mission and Departmental priorities. Translates executive vision into measurable goals, performance frameworks, and implementation roadmaps.

Establishes governance structures and decision-support processes to ensure alignment across multiple organizational components. Identifies enterprise risks, implementation implications, and resource gaps; formulates mitigation strategies and executive recommendations.

Provides executive-level oversight of priority initiatives and enterprise programs. Monitors performance metrics, deliverables, and compliance requirements. Directs cross-functional coordination to resolve barriers affecting execution. Develops executive dashboards and reporting mechanisms to inform leadership decision-making.

Ensures alignment with federal regulations, internal controls, and performance management frameworks. Serves as a principal executive staff resource to assigned HCO leadership in the planning, coordination, and integration of high-priority human capital initiatives and management matters having significant organizational impact.

Provides continuity and coordination across HCO functions and ensures matters requiring executive attention are appropriately analyzed, developed, and positioned for timely leadership action.

Reviews and assesses complex and sensitive matters involving HCO programs, operations, workforce issues, employee relations, organizational priorities, and management initiatives. Identifies interdependencies, conflicting requirements, implementation concerns, and matters requiring resolution or elevation.

Develops assessments, options, recommendations, and executive-level briefing materials to support management deliberations and decisions. Coordinates HCO responses and actions involving IRS organizations and, as appropriate, Treasury, OPM, oversight organizations, and other governmental entities.

Synthesizes information and recommendations from multiple HCO functions and organizational components; identifies unresolved issues or differing positions; and facilitates resolution or presents matters to leadership for decision.

Manages and coordinates executive-level actions arising from inquiries, reviews, audits, organizational initiatives, and other matters requiring HCO leadership attention. Evaluates submissions for completeness, responsiveness, consistency with established requirements and leadership direction, and potential impact on HCO programs and operations.

STANDARD POSITION DESCRIPTIONS (SPD): PD26068 Visit the IRS SPD Library to access the position descriptions.
Federal experience is not required. Experience may have been gained in the public sector, private sector or through Volunteer Service. One year of experience refers to full-time work; part-timework is considered on a prorated basis.

To ensure full credit for your work experience, please indicate dates of employment by month/day/year, and indicate number of hours worked per week, on your resume. You must meet the following requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: To qualify for this position, you must meet the qualification requirements outlined below: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE GS-15: To be minimally qualified for this position you must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level (GS-14) in the Federal Government.

Specialized experience is experience that is related to the work of this position and has provided you with the competencies required for successful job performance.

Specialized experience for this position includes: Experience serving as a trusted advisor to the executive on administrative, operational, and cross-organizational coordination matters impacting Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and departmental priorities, being the central coordination point between the executive office, external partners and interagency partners on sensitive and high-priority matters, and representing the Chief executive, as appropriate, and represent executive in internal coordination meetings and senior-level discussions focused on execution, alignment, and operational follow-through.

Experience with management principles, theories, and practices and their applicability to IRS' programs, functions, objectives, and the development of long-term strategic plans incorporating short-term and long-term goals.

Identify operational gaps, process inefficiencies, and coordination challenges; recommend and implement solutions to improve organizational effectiveness, responsiveness, and execution discipline.

Experience communicating both orally and in writing with internal and external stakeholders to persuade implementation of substantial changes in agency resources and established procedures. Synthesize input from senior leadership, interagency partners, and external stakeholders into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations.

Preparing agency directives, service-wide policy statements, briefing documents, status reports, and other written guidelines and recommendations.

Experience overseeing, coordinating and conducting the development of briefing material, presentations and negotiations on technical problems, outcomes, and recommendations to gain cooperation from top IRS officials and other top officials at federal, state, local, and non-government organizations to improve services provided, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with strategic objectives.

Establish and maintain effective relationships to gain confidence and cooperation of supervisors, managers, and co-workers to accept proposals.

AND You must also meet the following requirement(s): TIME AFTER COMPETITIVE APPOINTMENT (TACA): By the closing date (or if this is an open continuous announcement, by the cut-off date) specified in this job announcement, current civilian employees must have completed at least 90 days of federal civilian service since their latest non-temporary appointment from a competitive referral certificate, known as time after competitive appointment.

For this requirement, a competitive appointment is one where you applied to and were appointed from an announcement open to "All US Citizens" TIME IN GRADE (TIG): For positions above the GS-05, applicants must meet applicable time-in-­grade requirements to be considered eligible.

One year (52 weeks) at the next lower grade level is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the grade you are applying for. For positions at the GS-05, you cannot advance to the GS-05 if you have held a GS-02 in the past 52 weeks. There is no TIG restriction for GS-02, 03 or 04 positions.

For more information on qualifications please refer to OPM's Qualifications Standards.

Office Manager & Executive Assistant

ZGF Architects is seeking an experienced, highly capable administrative professional to join our team as Office Manager + Executive Assistant in our Washington, DC office. This is a dual-role position that combines responsibility for day-to-day office operations with executive-level administrative support to the Office Managing Partner and Design Partner.

We are looking for a self-directed, solutions-oriented individual who excels in collaboration and communication, embodies a strong hospitality mindset, and can seamlessly balance high-level executive support with operational leadership. This role plays a key part in supporting design excellence, business operations, and an exceptional workplace experience for staff and visitors.

Oversee day-to-day office management and operations, including facilities, building management, and vendor relationships
Maintain the aesthetic, functionality, safety, and security of the office environment
Coordinate with building management and service providers to ensure the office is clean, functional, and well supported
Manage and lead the local administration team, with accountability for training, workload oversight, performance feedback, and alignment with firmwide administrative standards
Manage and coordinate office-wide functions, events, and internal gatherings
Communicate and positively influence compliance with firm policies and procedures, ensuring clarity and understanding across the office
Develop and track the annual administrative budget in collaboration with office leadership and firmwide teams
Review and approve timesheets and expenses related to office overhead
Create, maintain, and communicate the office emergency preparedness plan; lead or participate in the Safety Committee
Collaborate with firmwide administrative leadership to identify efficiencies, create standards, and ensure consistent practices across offices

Provide high-level executive assistance to the Office Managing Partner and Design Partner, functioning as a trusted extension of leadership
Proactively increase Partner capacity by managing priorities, anticipating needs, and exercising discretion and independent judgment
Maintain complex calendars and schedules, coordinating business, project, and marketing-related meetings and logistics
Evaluate and respond on behalf of leadership to requests, balancing competing priorities across projects and offices
Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements in alignment with ZGF travel policy, including flights, lodging, ground transportation, and visas where applicable
Prepare expense reports and timesheets for Partners in a timely and accurate manner

s.h: Track Partner licensing and continuing education requirements
s.t:
Represent leadership professionally with clients, consultants, vendors, and the public
Provide backup support to front desk and collaborate with other Executive Assistants and Project Administrators as needed

Demonstrated experience in office management and office operations
Significant experience providing executive-level administrative support, preferably to senior leadership or Partners

Strong leadership, organizational, and prioritization skills
Professional and articulate communicator with the ability to engage effectively with a wide range of staff, consultants, clients, and vendors
Demonstrated ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality and discretion related to project, business, and personnel matters
Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with advanced proficiency in Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adopt new computer applications, with strong overall comfort leveraging technology to improve efficiency and workflows
Prior experience in a design, architecture, or engineering professional services environment preferred but not required
Knowledge of architectural/engineering terminology a plus
$104,000 - $122,000 annually, depending on skills and experience.

ZGF employees enjoy medical, dental, and vision coverage with a generous employer contribution; an HSA with employer contribution; a 401(k) with employer match; four weeks of PTO; 10 paid holidays per year; and paid parental and family leave programs.

For more than three decades, KPMB Architects has evolved in response to a changing world and worked to change it for the better. Guided by our purpose and anchored by our values, KPMB crafts design solutions that catalyze positive change.

As a full-service practice working across Canada and the United States, we provide expertise in building design, interior design, master planning, workplace strategy, project management, stakeholder engagement, and sustainable design. KPMB has designed and delivered projects totaling more than 31 million square feet in a diverse range of sectors, including education, healthcare, scientific research, arts and culture, government, corporate, hospitality, recreation, and mixed-use development.

With uncompromising rigor and close attention to the increasingly complex needs of the world around us, our diverse team devotes their expertise, passion, and creativity to solve today’s challenges and unlock new opportunities for our clients and the communities we serve.

s.h: The role / What are we looking for?
s.t:
KPMB is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Junior Executive Assistant professional to join our team. This administrative role is integral in ensuring that our executive team operates efficiently and effectively by providing comprehensive administrative support. You will be responsible in handling various tasks to ensure our executives can focus on their core responsibilities. The role demands a proactive, self-motivated individual who demonstrates initiative.

You will work closely with our Senior Executive Assistant to manage schedules, coordinate meetings, and ensure all administrative tasks are handled promptly and accurately. Ultimately, you will contribute to the smooth operation of our executive functions, keeping the team informed and on track with their deliverables and priorities.

Manage daily calendars for the Partners, scheduling meetings, conferences, events, appointments, and travel arrangements.
Work closely with the Executive administration team to maintain comprehensive and accurate records, including document management and filing systems.
Manage timesheets, expenses, and invoices for the Partners, including creating expense reports and submitting invoices for payment.

Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations, and other documents.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence including emails and phone calls, ensuring timely responses and follow-ups.
Assist in the preparation of reports, meeting agendas, and minutes.
Office license management (Partner’s licenses in various provinces and states, registration, licensing renewal, etc.)
Front desk coverage when Receptionist is away.

Take detailed minutes during internal and external meetings, ensuring all action items are clearly documented and distributed to relevant personnel.
Coordinate and communicate with various departments, stakeholders, and external partners to facilitate smooth operations.

Update meeting agendas and take detailed minutes for Business Development and Marketing meetings.
Schedule content development meetings, calls, and calendar coordination for team members and external collaborators.
Ensure corporate memberships for various associations are current, including registrations and renewals.
Administrative coordination for sponsorships and marketing activations: digital filing for contracts, reports, invoices, etc.
Handle conference and event registration and RSVPs for Leadership.
Manage travel arrangements for conferences, meetings, and events for partners and team members.
Lead coordination of marketing events, including liaising with third-party vendors.
Assist in preparation and distribution for marketing collateral (technical prep, mailings).
Coordinate logistics for internal and external meeting (venue booking, catering, AV, guest lists).
Serve as point of contact between Marketing/Business Development team and other business functions.
Maintain CRM database to ensure up-to-date, accurate, and legible experience.
Pull reports from marketing software.

A minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar administrative or assistant role.
Ability to multitask, managing a high volume of work and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency with MS Office Suite.
Outstanding organizational, schedule coordination, and administrative skills.
Ability to work well in a collaborative team environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Praised to have problem solving and critical thinking skills.
A self-starter who demonstrates initiative.

Founded in 1987, KPMB Architects has developed a diverse portfolio of architectural projects that focus on building healthy, vibrant cities and communities. The firm has grown to include over 100 employees and is recognized for its highly collaborative and supportive culture, as well as its wide variety of experience and educational backgrounds.

Some of our team members have grown with the firm from the start of their careers to become leaders, while others have joined at various points in their careers, bringing new ideas and approaches.

We provide a learning environment where teaching, mentoring, and collaboration are integral parts of our DNA. At KPMB, there are numerous opportunities to share your skills, engage in firm activities beyond project work, and contribute to our initiatives that give back to the community.

KPMB is committed to fostering a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we operate in and serve. KPMB Architects is an Equal Opportunity Employer that considers applicants regardless of age, race, colour, national origin, citizenship, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected status.

A daily free shuttle bus between Union Station and KPMB’s office is provided for all staff who use the subway system or GO transit, from Monday to Thursday. Underground bicycle parking is also available.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI tools to support application screening. All applications are ultimately reviewed and assessed by qualified members of our recruitment team.

Executive Assistant - Chicago

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant to support our partnership team. The ideal candidate will be resourceful, detail-oriented, mission focused, and capable of handling a wide range of administrative and executive support tasks.

The chosen candidate will have at least six years of full-time, onsite experience in a professional office setting with a proven record of success in all areas required of the role. This position is a member of the Administrative Team, which includes HR, Operations, and Office Managers. The position reports to the Director of HR but works directly for the partner.

This position is full-time and based onsite in our Chicago office in the West Loop area. Benefits can be found listed on our careers page.

These responsibilities reflect the dynamic role of an Executive Assistant, where flexibility, organization, and proactive support are essential to the business's success and efficiency.

Administrative Support

Manage partners' calendars and schedules, including arranging appointments and meetings.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence, including emails, letters, and calls.
Prepare reports and presentations for meetings and presentations.
Support partners with quarterly goals and other small projects as requested.
Ensure completion of all tasks with high focus on prompt follow-through.
Anticipate partners' needs and proactively handle administrative tasks.
Conduct research and compile data for executive decision-making.
Handle personal tasks and errands as requested.

Communication Liaison

Handle requests and queries appropriately.
Act as a liaison between partners, teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.
Coordinate client meetings and events, ensuring a smooth experience.
Ability to acknowledge the sensitivity and maintain privacy of internal partner and leadership coordination.
Ensure partner and leadership dialog in sensitive matters held in confidence.

Travel and Accommodation Arrangements

Arrange travel itineraries, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation.
Prepare travel agendas (often with input from other team members), necessary documents, and expense reports.
Share the partners’ travel agendas with other team members for coordination.
Ensure travel plans align with partners' schedules and preferences.

Data Management and Record Keeping

Maintain accurate records and files, both electronic and physical.
Ensure information confidentiality and data protection.

Share opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
Implement best practices in administrative support.
Stay updated on industry trends and administrative tools to enhance job performance.

Proven experience as an executive or administrative assistant or similar administrative role.
Excellent MS Office knowledge and proficiency and Abobe Suite, specifics experience with InDesign and PowerPoint.
Outstanding organizational and time management skills.
Ability to multitask and prioritize daily workload.
Discretion and confidentiality.
Knowledge of EOS and the supporting platform (Bloomgrowth) is a plus but not required.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
A proactive approach to problem-solving with strong decision-making skills.
Bachelor’s degree in business administration or relevant experience.
Experience in a business environment.
Expertise in project management tools and software.
Experience managing and coordinating requests from multiple staff.

Work Environment: Monday through Friday 8:30-5:30 with an hour for lunch/breaks.
Benefits: Health benefits, paid time off, 401(k), to/from office commute paid, or parking provided, and opportunities for career growth within a dynamic and expanding company.

Salary: Range is $70,000-$85,000; the offer will be based on experience, skills and background in similar positions.

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter outlining their qualifications and why they are interested in working with us. Please include any relevant work samples or references. Send application information to the Director of Human Resources: Meg Graham and mgraham@hoerrschaudt.com

Specific duties include: The Executive Assistant supports MDEO's Executive Director by independently coordinating administrative functions to include correspondence, communications, personnel management, financial support, meeting schedules, scheduling of briefings including hearings, suspense and control items, space needs, and other analysis of information or refinement of recommendations and proposals.

Assists the Executive Director on highly visible and important formal responses, testimonies, and hearings. Works on Congressional testimony and hearing preparation; assists with establishing or articulating VA's position on broad issues with significant and wide-ranging impact.

The incumbent completes special projects that are complex in nature and have significant impact on VBA initiatives. The work requires a high level of interaction with VBA senior leaders and the issues are typically controversial and highly visible.

Maintains a broad knowledge and understanding of VA and VBA policies, missions, automation, and operating programs and must remain acutely aware of administration policies and government-wide initiatives having a direct impact on VBA and MDEO. The incumbent applies expert analytical skills and division goals in evaluating various program areas.

The incumbent uses expertise and judgment in creating recommendations for the Executive Director. Exercises objectivity and awareness of the mission and responsibilities of the Executive Director in the priority setting process.

The incumbent screens visitors and telephone calls by obtaining background information to determine which calls or visitors must be directed to the Executive Director, others, or can be handled personally.

Provides technical assistance and guidance on preparation, coordination, and administrative processing of executive office actions including conducting research to develop presentations, briefings, and other executive materials.

Initiates and drafts memoranda and position papers, together with other special reports and analytical studies on items of special interest or controversial issues that are of high department or public interest. Exercises a high level of judgment in determining and advising on courses of action.

Presents, or arranges for presentations, regarding matters related to current policy and program changes. The incumbent develops standard procedures involving the administrative operations for the office and develops systems which monitor, track, and control a wide variety of items requiring action by the Executive Director and staff for the office.

Prepares, edits, and reviews incoming and outgoing executive communications, briefing papers, correspondence, and other materials. Prepares presentations, spreadsheets, databases, and other materials utilizing appropriate technology. Provides executive summaries, interpretation of policy implications, or cogent recommendations pertaining to content.

Acts as a gatekeeper to prevent inappropriate requests, incomplete proposals, inconsequential issues, and erroneous facts. Confirms appropriate stakeholders have identified and resolved all relevant information, prior to requesting executive leadership signature or endorsement.

Independently resolves issues and provides a complete solution so the Executive Director only needs to give approval or disapproval of the proposal. The EA works with the MDE budget team, in preparation of the administrative budget, ensuring it is ready for Executive Director review and concurrence.

Maintains continued awareness of overall activities in order to evaluate effectiveness and to keep the Executive Director informed and recommends actions to strengthen operating and administrative policies and procedures, and/or to advise staff on priority matters of concern.

Takes final action in connection with the application of managerial and administrative functions that are within delegated authority.

Incumbent is required to be aware constantly of the overall MDEO program and to recognize those areas with which the Executive Director should not be burdened, what actions and commitments should be made without reference to her/him and what matters require his/her counsel or decisions before arriving at final conclusions.

Work Schedule: Full time, Monday through Friday Compressed/Flexible: Not Available Telework: This position is eligible for situational (ad hoc) telework only. The selectee is required to report to the official duty station each scheduled workday. Telework may be approved only on a case-by-case basis with supervisory approval.

Routine or recurring telework is not authorized for this position. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Position Description/PD#: Executive Assistant; PD 421060 Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Financial Disclosure Report: Not Required Duty Hours: 8:00 - 4:30pm
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement: 08/28/2026. TIME-IN-GRADE REQUIREMENT: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements.

For a GS-14 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-13 level. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENT: You may qualify based on your experience and/or education as described below: GS-14 Grade Level: Specialized Experience: To qualify for this position at the GS-14 level, applicants must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 level.

Direct trust from both co-founders, full visibility into the company, and a position that grows as the company does.

V-ZUG steht für Schweizer Qualität und Präzision. * Du planst und organisierst Meetings der International Markets von A bis Z: von der Einladung über die Agenda bis zum Protokoll - du hast den Überblick und den Drive, damit Meetings wirklich etwas bewegen

* Du pflegst und entwickelst den Intranet- und SharePoint-Bereich der International Markets weiter und agierst als IT-Power-User: Du unterstützt die CIO und das internationale Team bei Beschaffungen und bist erste Ansprechperson bei technischen Fragen und Problemen
* Du bringst dich aktiv in Sonderprojekte ein: Du unterstützt bei PowerPoint-Präsentationen, bündelst und konsolidierst Informationen aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und übernimmst bei Bedarf eine tragende Rolle in Projekten - mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum

* Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine gleichwertige Grundausbildung - beispielsweise auch im Hospitality-Umfeld (z.-B. Hotelfachschule). Ein Weiterbildungsabschluss als Executive Assistant oder Direktionsassistenz ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
* Du bist fit im gesamten Microsoft-Kosmos: SharePoint, Copilot, Outlook, Word, Excel und PowerPoint setzt du versiert und effizient ein - du weisst, wie man diese Tools wirklich nutzt, nicht nur bedient
* Du kommunizierst fliessend auf Deutsch und Englisch - schriftlich wie mündlich. Weitere Sprachen sind willkommen und ein echtes Plus in einem internationalen Umfeld
* Du bist dienstleistungsorientiert durch und durch: Du findest pragmatische Lösungen, behältst auch in turbulenten Situationen die Ruhe und trittst nach innen wie nach aussen professionell auf - als Visitenkarte der CIO und der International Markets
* Du denkst und planst voraus, handelst aus eigener Initiative und bist bereit, dir technisches und fachliches Know-how selbstständig anzueignen - Stillstand ist nicht dein Ding
* Du bist strukturiert, systematisch und zuverlässig - Menschen wissen, dass Dinge, die du übernimmst, erledigt sind. Und das mit der nötigen Sorgfalt
* Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen, bist unkompliziert im Umgang und kannst das Unternehmen professionell gegenüber externen Gästen, Partnern und Märkten vertreten - mit der richtigen Mischung aus Verbindlichkeit und Herzlichkeit

PRECI-DIP SA - Delémont est une société leader à l'international dans la fabrication de composants électroniques (contacts et connecteurs). Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons pour notre secteur Supply Chain un:
**Coordinateur Prototypes & Sous-traitance**
**Votre mission**
Sous la responsabilité du Directeur Supply Chain, vous assurez la planification et le suivi de tous les nouveaux projets et prototypes de la société. En étroite collaboration avec le département R&D, vous coordonnerez les activités internes et en sous-traitance pour l'ensemble des nouveaux produits.

Vous lancez et suivez également les ordres de fabrication, ainsi que les commandes d'achats. Grâce à vos compétences techniques, vous comprenez les flux industriels, les processus de fabrication et les contraintes de production. Proche du terrain, vous appréciez collaborer avec les ateliers et les différents acteurs de la chaîne de valeur afin d'assurer un suivi concret des activités.

Doté d'excellentes capacités de communication, vous interagissez aisément avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes, coordonnez les prestataires et assurez une circulation fluide de l'information. Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi qu'un ERP et possédez de bonnes connaissances en anglais.

Une activité à responsabilités, intéressante et variée, avec une importante autonomie. **Rejoignez Nescens, la marque suisse experte en longévité.**
Nescens est une institution suisse de référence dans les domaines de la médecine préventive et de la longévité. Elle réunit deux univers complémentaires : une ligne de skincare scientifique, nos cosméceutiques, distribuée dans un réseau de point de ventes sélectifs et en ligne, et des programmes de bilan diagnostique et de longévité dispensés en clinique et dans des établissements hôteliers partenaires de référence.
Basée sur le prestigieux campus médical de Genolier, Nescens fait partie d'un écosystème unique où la science, la médecine et le bien-être se rencontrent.
Rejoindre Nescens, c'est intégrer un environnement dynamique, stimulant et tourné vers l'innovation, au cœur de la science suisse de la longévité.
## Description du poste ##
Ce poste vient renforcer l'équipe Guest Journey Coordinator, déjà composée de deux personnes, dans le cadre du développement et de l'expansion des programmes Nescens : multiplication des programmes (Essential Reset et suivants), montée en volume de la clientèle internationale haut de gamme, et déploiement progressif sur de nouveaux sites.

Il répond au besoin d'un lead supplémentaire dédié à l'expérience client, capable de garantir la cohérence et la qualité du parcours à mesure que l'offre s'étend, et de soutenir l'Innovation Program Manager dans le déploiement terrain de chaque nouveau programme.
**Rôle**
Le GuestJourney Coordinator est le lead de l'expérience client sur les programmes Nescens : il anime le parcours du client de bout en bout, coordonne l'ensemble des intervenants, et incarne la promesse haut de gamme de la marque. Le poste intègre certains gestes techniques simples, réalisés sous délégation médicale. Il apporte également son expertise terrain au Program Manager dans le développement de nouveaux programmes, et est référent formation auprès des équipes.

\- Être l'interlocuteur unique du client avant, pendant et après le programme, afin de garantir un accompagnement continu, individualisé et une expérience haut de gamme.
\- Animer le déroulé du programme au quotidien : rythme, transitions entre intervenants, ajustements en temps réel selon les attentes du client.
\- Porter la relation client comme un ambassadeur de la marque Nescens, au même titre qu'un rôle d'hôte : anticiper les besoins, personnaliser l'expérience, gérer les imprévus avec fluidité.
\- Recueillir les retours clients en continu et les faire remonter pour nourrir l'amélioration de l'expérience et des programmes.

\- Assurer l'organisation et le suivi du parcours personnalisé du client, en coordonnant les prises en charge et en harmonisant les plannings selon les besoins et objectifs.
\- Coordonner les intervenants indépendants (praticiens bien-être, thérapeutes, nutritionnistes...) et les médecins : planification, suivi des conventions et du bon déroulement des prestations.
\- Assurer l'interface avec les équipes hôtelières et spa pour la bonne exécution logistique des séjours.
\- Assurer la gestion administrative et du dossier client, de sa constitution à son suivi, incluant la traçabilité et la facturation.

\- Veiller à la sécurité et au confort du client lors des thérapies de médecine intégrative.

# **Adjoint ou Adjointe de direction, responsable de l'unité entretien des espaces verts à 80-100%** #
**Votre mission et vos responsabilités**
\- Diriger et organiser l'unité Entretien des espaces verts et piloter l'ensemble de ses activités stratégiques, opérationnelles, administratives, légales et financières.
\- Encadrer les membres du personnel de l'unité (environ 170) répartis dans les différents secteurs, fixer les objectifs, les soutenir et les accompagner dans leur mission.
\- Elaborer les directives et les processus nécessaires à la bonne gestion et permettant la mise en oeuvre des plans de gestion et des différentes stratégies de la Ville de Genève (végétalisation, climat, biodiversité).
\- Optimiser les moyens et les ressources allouées (humaines, techniques et financières, etc.).
\- Veiller à la cohérence des pratiques d'exploitation entre les secteurs, à la planification du travail et à la juste adéquation des ressources aux besoins de l'unité.
\- Définir une politique de gestion durable des espaces verts (revalorisation des espaces verts en faveur de l'environnement, changement climatique et développement de la biodiversité).
\- Assurer la communication interne au sein de l'unité.
**Votre profil**
\- Être titulaire d'un diplôme HES en gestion de la nature ou en agronomie ou d'une formation jugée équivalente.
\- Justifier d'une expérience confirmée de 5 années minimum, incluant le management d'équipes opérationnelles de grande taille et la gestion d'un budget.
\- Avoir une maîtrise des espaces verts, de leur entretien et de leur exploitation.
\- Être capable d'avoir une réelle vision stratégique et organisationnelle et de prendre des initiatives innovantes.
\- Faire preuve de leadership et d'excellentes compétences relationnelles, d'un sens développé des contacts humains et d'aisance dans la communication.
\- Disposer d'un sens de l'organisation et des priorités ainsi que d'une capacité d'analyse et de synthèse.
\- Maîtriser la réglementation en vigueur au niveau communal, cantonal et fédéral en lien avec la gestion des espaces verts.
Dans le cadre de sa politique d'égalité entre femmes et hommes, la Ville de Genève souhaite promouvoir la mixité dans tous les services de l'administration. Les candidatures féminines sont donc particulièrement encouragées pour ce poste.

About Zego
Insurance hasn’t changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.
Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.
At Zego, we’re leading the AI evolution in insurance.
We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes.

Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers.

Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.

We are looking for a part-time, AI first Executive Assistant to provide first class support to the CEO and CFO. This is a role for someone who thrives on variety and can move fluidly between high level strategic support and the practical detail that keeps a fast moving leadership function running smoothly. You will use AI tools as your default way of working, from research and drafting through to automating repetitive administrative tasks.

You will act as a trusted right hand to the team, with a clear grasp of their priorities and full ownership of complex diary management.
You will support team activities and meetings, and provide occasional support for offsites and events led by the Leadership team.
You will oversee work-streams as directed, including collating slides, conducting market research, and handling other ad hoc tasks within the scope of the role.
You will manage incoming communications, triaging by priority, drafting replies, and liaising with external parties on the team's behalf, ensuring all correspondence and requests are handled accurately and on time.
You will coordinate Leadership team meetings end to end, including logistics such as video conferencing, venue booking, and offsite travel arrangements, alongside building agendas and presentation materials. This involves close collaboration across internal teams and external parties, and independent research.
You will handle travel management on the occasions the team travels, including flights, rail, hotels, and visas.
You will manage expense processing on behalf of the CEO and CFO, ensuring claims are accurate, timely, and compliant with company policy.
You will attend key meetings as directed by the Leadership team, take thorough minutes, and own the follow-up of action points through to resolution.
You will maintain organisational records and documentation on behalf of the Leadership team, including legal paperwork, passports, and biographies.
What you’ll need to be successful
Have prior EA experience gained in a high change, fast paced startup environment.
Work effectively in a distributed, remote first setup, collaborating fluently via Google Meet.
Have experience managing calendars for multiple team members simultaneously.
Be confident with video conferencing tools, ideally Zoom and Google Meet.
Have excellent IT skills across Google and Microsoft suites.
Have demonstrable AI skills, using tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to synthesise research into decision ready insights, build first drafts of decks and briefing documents, and automate recurring admin so the team's time is protected for what matters most.
Operate one step ahead, knowing the team's diaries inside out, anticipating where they need to be, when, and with the right paperwork in hand.
What it’s like to work at Zego
At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.
Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards, moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.
This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.
Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor .
The Zego ways of working
Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid . In this role we would ask you to be in the office one day per week. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room regularlaly. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It is a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like .
If you’re ready to help build the real-time, data-driven infrastructure for an intelligent world, we want to hear from you.

In dieser vertrauensvollen Funktion arbeiten Sie eng mit dem CEO zusammen und unterstützen ihn bei der Vorbereitung, Koordination und Nachverfolgung von Geschäftsleitungs\-, Verwaltungsrats\-, Projekt\- und Organisationsthemen.
Sie sorgen dafür, dass Informationen strukturiert vorliegen, Entscheide sauber dokumentiert, offene Punkte konsequent weiterverfolgt und wichtige Themen zum richtigen Zeitpunkt wieder aufgenommen werden.
Assistenz CEO 50\-60% (m/w/d)

**Ihre Aufgaben**
* Vorbereitung, Koordination und Nachbereitung von Geschäftsleitungssitzungen und Verwaltungsratsunterlagen
* Strukturierung und Zusammenstellung von Traktanden, Sitzungsunterlagen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen

* Koordination von Terminen, Abstimmungen und Follow\-ups im direkten Umfeld des CEO
**Ihr Profil**
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als CEO\-/GL\-Assistenz, Executive Assistant, Projektassistenz oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit Nähe zu Geschäftsleitung oder Unternehmensführung
* Ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit und sehr strukturierte, selbständige Arbeitsweise
* Hohe Diskretion, Integrität und Vertrauenswürdigkeit
* Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte rasch zu erfassen, zu strukturieren und auf das Wesentliche zu reduzieren
* Freude daran, Themen konsequent nachzuverfolgen und Verbindlichkeit professionell einzufordern

Sie denken mit, behalten auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick und erkennen, was als Nächstes ötigt wird.
Sie verstehen Ihre Rolle nicht als reine administrative Unterstützung, sondern als strukturierende Kraft im Hintergrund. Sie tragen dazu bei, dass Führungsprozesse strukturiert vorbereitet, Entscheide sauber dokumentiert und vereinbarte Massnahmen konsequent nachverfolgt werden.
Dabei arbeiten Sie diskret, verbindlich und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch.

* Die Möglichkeit, Führungs\- und Arbeitsstrukturen aktiv mitzugestalten
* Ein hohes Mass an Selbständigkeit und Eigenverantwortung
* Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz am Hauptsitz der Häny AG in Jona

How You’ll Make a Difference
Stopping the Scroll: You will turn raw photos and video footage into high-performing, scroll-stopping content—including shorts, reels, and standard posts—across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Google Business Profile (GBP) for three distinct brands.
Owning the Brand Narrative: You will take creative control by independently building and managing the content calendar while designing engaging social graphics, flyers, and promotional assets using Canva or Adobe that strictly adhere to existing brand guidelines.
Building Local Authority: You will actively foster community trust by handling comments and DMs, identifying and posting in relevant local Facebook groups, and supporting basic SEO and backlink health tied to GBP to generate organic inbound leads.
Driving Real-World Connections: You will research and coordinate local trade show and networking opportunities (such as Alignable, BNI, and Chamber of Commerce events) by handling outreach, event registrations, scheduling, and sponsorship correspondence.

Is This You?
The Creative Strategist: You have proven hands-on experience in social media management, graphic design, and video editing (backed by a strong portfolio of work samples), and you aren't afraid to bring fresh ideas, professional judgment, and constructive opinions to the table.
The Autonomous Owner: You thrive in a low-oversight environment and are excited to transition from close approval-based work during onboarding to independently owning the marketing strategy as a genuine thought partner—with the ambition to grow into a future marketing supervisor role.
The Brand Chameleon: You are detail-oriented and comfortable managing three distinct companies under one ownership group simultaneously, effortlessly adapting your content style to represent the unique tone and credibility of the home services and trades industry.
Tech-Savvy: You have a solid working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Google Workspace, and Google Business Profile management, and you are comfortable communicating directly with the business owner primarily via WhatsApp.
Your Home Office: You have a reliable personal computer capable of handling professional-grade design and video editing workloads in a BYOD setup, paired with a stable, high-speed internet connection and a quiet work-from-home environment aligned with Eastern Time business hours.

Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit.
Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Und wenn eine Glühbirne gewechselt oder ein Griff festgeschraubt werden muss, machst du das auch einfach selbst.

Background
Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, eine Ausbildung in Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Eventmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Hintergrund. Entscheidend ist für uns aber nicht dein konkreter Abschluss, sondern dass du bereits relevante praktische Erfahrung mitbringst.

Du hast Erfahrung im Office Management, Workplace Management, Hospitality, Eventmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.

The Company You’ll Join
Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions.

Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .
The Problems You'll Solve
At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Regional Office Manager, AMEA, you'll work to:
Build and sustain a best-in-class front-of-house experience for the Singapore hub, setting the standard for how Carta shows up to employees, guests, and building partners across the region.
Own the operational infrastructure that keeps the Singapore office running — vendor relationships, building liaison, access control systems, and daily procedures — so employees can focus on their work rather than logistics.
Ensure physical security and compliance by managing the Envoy guest system, keycard access controls, and local Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) protocols.
Partner with Onboarding, IT, and People teams to design seamless new hire experiences — from desk setup and welcome kits to coordinated day-one logistics.
Create meaningful employee experience moments through Singapore office events, cultural celebrations, and Company Days that build a sense of community in the region.
Serve as an operational resource for APAC satellite offices during team expansions, leave periods, or new office launches — including traveling onsite when hands-on support is needed (up to 20% travel)

You'll be joining Carta's People & Workplace Experience team.
Singapore is Carta's primary Asia hub and a cornerstone of the company's international growth. The Workplace Experience team ensures that every Carta employee — from a day-one new hire to a visiting executive — has the physical environment, operational infrastructure, and human support they need to do their best work.

This team sits within the broader People organization and partners closely with IT, Recruiting, and Finance to keep offices running smoothly across geographies. As Carta's regional footprint expands, this team's work grows in both complexity and consequence — and this role sits at the center of it.

Operationally self-sufficient. You have 3+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, or facilities coordination — ideally in a tech startup or fast-paced corporate environment — and you run things without waiting to be told.
People-first professional. You bring warmth and polish to every interaction, whether welcoming a visitor, resolving an employee request, or navigating a vendor issue under pressure.
Regionally adaptable. You're comfortable working across cultures and time zones, and you're ready and willing to travel within APAC on short notice when business needs arise.
Tech-fluent. You're confident in Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and modern guest and access control systems such as Envoy and keycard management platforms.
Clear, confident communicator. You write and speak in English with precision and professionalism, and you manage upward, across teams, and with external partners with equal ease.
At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

As Assistant Boutique Manager, you will support the Boutique Manager in ensuring the smooth daily operation of the onboard boutiques while delivering an exceptional shopping experience to our guests.

You will contribute to maintaining high retail standards, supporting team coordination, and creating a professional and welcoming environment aligned with MSC Cruises- luxury hospitality values.

· Experience working in multicultural and fast-paced environments
· Previous cruise ship experience preferred

s.h: To succeed in this role, you-ll need

· Additional European languages are considered an advantage depending on itinerary
· Strong communication and interpersonal skills
· Team-oriented mindset with leadership potential
